rules.statement: The evidence did not support the conclusion that the property was Harris' property, as the letter indicated it was a private arrangement between the appellant and the Syndicate.
rules.supporting_quote: On this view of the letter it is plain, in their Lordships' judgment, that it afforded no evidence that the monies were paid to the appellant as agent for Harris or that such monies by reason of the payment to the appellant became Harris' property. On the contrary, it was an essential feature of what was done that the arrangement should remain a private one between the appellant and the Syndicate, of which no one else was to know anything.
